PROGRESSING.description: At least one admitted durable state change reduced remaining work since the previous checkpoint.

MONITORING_BLOCKED.description: Worker is alive and rechecking a known blocker, but remaining work has not decreased.

STALLED.description: Worker should be able to act but has produced no qualifying progress transition within its task-specific permitted progress window.

COMPLETED.description: Task terminal success predicates are satisfied with durable evidence.

archive_effect.PROGRESSING: may support non-terminal handoff only when every unfinished inherited goal is PROGRESSING
